name: stage5_supplementary
registered: 2026-09-26 ~23:45 UTC-6, before any Stage-5 model run or result (only coordinate-based partition checks)
status: supplementary robustness stage addressing inference units, seed variance, HAC bandwidth, baselines, alternative spatial partitions and neighbour availability; does not retroactively pre-register the random-vs-spatial narrative

A_seeds.seed_ensemble: mean of mu and mean of sigma over seeds (unchanged)

B_partitions_euppbench.why_single_start_for_extra_K7: n_init=20 with other seeds returns the primary partition or near-copies (ARI 0.79-1.0); computed from coordinates only

C_new_baselines.local_emos: per station and lead, mu=a+b m, sigma^2=c^2+d^2 s^2, min-CRPS (fit_emos); own-station fit never used for a held-out station
C_new_baselines.emos_nn1: coefficients of nearest training station (distance sqrt(d_km^2+(0.1 km/m * dalt)^2))
C_new_baselines.emos_idw: IDW k=5, weights 1/d, same kernel as nn_knn (knn_idw)
C_new_baselines.emos_reg: OLS of each coefficient (a, b, c^2, d^2) on [1, lat, lon, alt, orog, alt-orog] over training stations, per lead
C_new_baselines.emos_regidw: PRIMARY interpolated baseline: emos_reg trend + IDW(k=5) of station residuals
C_new_baselines.samos_lin: Stage-4 attribute-ridge climatology (Climatology class, clim_ridge=1.0, clim_max_rows=400000) for obs and t2m ensemble mean; global EMOS per lead in anomaly space z_y ~ N(a+b z_f, c^2+d^2 z_s^2); back-transformed

also: validation-selected m (fit <=2014, min CRPS on training stations' 2015-2016 reforecasts)
bst_iteration_sensitivity.note: only validation-selected m may be proposed as alternative; fixed-m test scores are sensitivity only

D_inference.delta: CRPS_A - CRPS_B on held-out rows pooled over folds (negative = A better)

primary.type: station-cluster bootstrap with nested seed resampling

co_primary.type: fold-block bootstrap nested with seed resampling

dm.series: per-day mean delta (German date, EUPPBench initialisation date)
dm.hac: Bartlett, automatic bandwidth Newey-West (1994) [primary], Andrews (1991) AR(1) [sensitivity]

D_inference.multiplicity: BH q=0.05 within (dataset, fold type) over pair list, primary DM
ranking_probabilities: pairwise P(A<B) from nested station bootstrap
seed-only: P(single-seed A < single-seed B) over seed pairs

E_m1a.issue: neighbour availability = isfinite(y) & isfinite(ens mean) (stage4_run.py:49 gnn aggregation, stage4_pilot.py:144 samos_attn neighbours)
E_m1a.fix: neighbour availability = forecast availability; training loss/scoring still on observed rows
E_m1a.euppbench: scripts/stage5_preprocess_fcavail.py extracts forecast features of missing-observation (slice, station) pairs of included stations from local zarr copy
E_m1a.german: not fixable: published RL18 file contains forecast rows only where obs exist (forecast availability = observation availability in our data); disclosed, not rerun
E_m1a.impact: delta CRPS fixed-original with station bootstrap CI; fraction of held-out test (slice, station) whose neighbour set changes
E_m1a.rule: original stays primary; if |delta| >= 0.005 degC report fixed numbers alongside

F_decision_rules.C1_supported: EUPPBench primary spatial, 10 seeds: DiD_drn>0 and DiD_gnn>0 with station CI excluding 0 AND for each F point estimate (F-E)_partition-(F-E)_random > 0 in >=4 of 6 partitions
F_decision_rules.C1_contradicted: either DiD CI entirely below 0, or either F has DiD<=0 in >=4 of 6 partitions
F_decision_rules.C1_otherwise: inconclusive; wording 'in this benchmark the primary spatial partition suggests ...' with interval
F_decision_rules.C1_fold_block_note: fold-block CI including 0 does not overturn 'supported' but text must say effect concentrated in few regions, named from per-fold table
F_decision_rules.C2_reversal: only if random F-E<0 with station CI excl 0 AND spatial F-E>0 with station CI excl 0
F_decision_rules.C3_sparse_specific: only if C1 supported on EUPPBench AND German DiD_F CI includes 0 or lies below 0 for both F; always note density confounded with domain/leads/predictors
F_decision_rules.C4_pairwise: claim only if nested station-bootstrap CI excludes 0 AND BH-adjusted primary DM rejects; station CI excl 0 but fold-block CI incl 0 -> 'better on average over stations, not consistently across regions'; station CI incl 0 -> 'statistically tied'
F_decision_rules.C5_seeds: if nested-bootstrap P(A<B) in [0.1, 0.9] no ordering is stated
F_decision_rules.C6_baselines: if emos_regidw or samos_lin beats every network on EUPPBench spatial it is reported and included in conclusions; no Stage-5 outcome removes a previously reported result

G_compute.scope_cut: after 22 h wall since launch, unstarted jobs dropped in reverse priority (final evaluation always runs); incomplete partitions excluded entirely; documented in NOTES_stage5.md

unchanged: data, folds, periods, hyper-parameters, seen-station early stopping; no test score selects any setting; smoke tests on subsamples to /tmp, discarded
